description: Check whether a card number or other ID passes the Luhn (mod 10) algorithm used by card numbers, IMEI numbers and many IDs, and compute the check digit to append. Only the format is checked; nothing is looked up. Use to catch typos in card or ID numbers. Example: number=79927398713. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: validate_luhn
title: Credit card validation (Luhn)
